curation.name: Maximum-Height Jump
curation.summary: Height-optimized one-shot vertical hop with an optional standing-policy handoff for a quiet reset.
curation.details: The canonical ONNX contains the jump controller. The repository documents a separate standing-policy handoff and publisher-side MuJoCo measurements; those claims are not registry simulation evidence.
curation.notes: The handoff policy is not folded into this entry's immutable artifact identity.
